# Evan Applegate

> Evan Applegate is an award-winning cartographer and information designer. His maps appear in National Geographic and Manhattan offices; he makes LED-backlit map art (Radiant Maps), maps for organizations (The Map Consultancy), map blankets and prints (Quercus Maps), and a podcast interviewing cartographers (Very Expensive Maps).

Links: https://www.linkedin.com/in/evan-applegate/, https://github.com/evanapplegate

## Pages

- [Evan Applegate](https://evanapplegate.com/): Evan Applegate is an award-winning cartographer and information designer: maps for National Geographic and Manhattan offices, backlit map art, map blankets and a podcast interviewing cartographers.
- [Map design files](https://evanapplegate.com/map-design-files/): Source files for select maps by cartographer Evan Applegate, mostly public domain.
- [2025 Map Gift Guide](https://evanapplegate.com/map-gifts/): Only the best mapstuff from independent cartographers, globemakers and artists: an incomplete list by cartographer Evan Applegate, no affiliate links.
- [Evan Applegate's blog](https://evanapplegate.com/evans_blog/): Essays on cartography, machine learning, nursing, eldercare and more.
